purpose: Non-admission discovery of World Monitor upstream sources potentially useful to OpenCatastrophe catastrophe event monitoring, secondary impacts, critical infrastructure and exposure context; not a claim of source admission or source dataset rights.

entries.name: NASA EONET Natural Events API v3
entries.provider: NASA Earth Observatory Natural Event Tracker
entries.temporal_scope: near-real-time and historic event metadata, variable by event
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Event IDs, dates, categories, source links, point and polygon geometries
entries.note: EONET is curated event metadata, not a complete hazard footprint, surveyed damage or loss. Freeze original event ID, all geometry timestamps and underlying sources; a World Monitor dashboard may drop polygon detail. Discovery evidence: World Monitor source-attribution manifest host eonet.gsfc.nasa.gov, code scripts/seed-natural-events.mjs; independently verify direct provider terms and exact product before use.

entries.name: Canadian Wildland Fire Information System operational products
entries.temporal_scope: current and historical coverage, product dependent
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Fire locations, danger/weather indexes, burned area and linked spatial services
entries.note: Current fire locations are not necessarily perimeters; satellite and agency reports may disagree. Product, layer, timestamp and regional authority must be frozen separately. Discovery evidence: World Monitor source-attribution manifest host geoserver.cwfif.nrcan.gc.ca, code scripts/wildfire/cwfis-wfs.mjs; independently verify direct provider terms and exact product before use.

entries.name: Earthquakes Canada catalogue and significant events
entries.temporal_scope: recent and historical earthquakes, operational revisions
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Epicentres, magnitude, depth, event type and event identifiers
entries.note: World Monitor uses an NRCan Atom adapter. Quarry blasts and mine-induced events may appear alongside tectonic events; preserve event type and catalogue version. Discovery evidence: World Monitor source-attribution manifest host www.earthquakescanada.nrcan.gc.ca, code scripts/seismology/nrcan-atom.mjs; independently verify direct provider terms and exact product before use.

entries.name: NOAA NHC operational tropical cyclone GIS products
entries.spatial_scope: Atlantic and eastern North Pacific as product coverage permits
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Forecast tracks, uncertainty cones, advisories and wind fields depending on layer
entries.note: Forecast cones are not wind footprints or loss probabilities. Store storm ID, advisory number, issuance time, basin and layer; do not substitute forecasts for best track. Discovery evidence: World Monitor source-attribution manifest host mapservices.weather.noaa.gov, code scripts/seed-natural-events.mjs; independently verify direct provider terms and exact product before use.

entries.name: US National Weather Service CAP alerts
entries.spatial_scope: United States and NWS coverage regions
entries.temporal_scope: operational active alerts; historical retention restricted
entries.resolution_or_granularity: CAP v1.2 alerts in XML and JSON-LD with event areas and validity windows
entries.note: Operational alerts describe warned areas and uncertainty, not measured extreme-wind, hail or flood footprints; respect NWS rate limit and expiration. Discovery evidence: World Monitor source-attribution manifest host api.weather.gov, code scripts/_weather-alert-select.mjs; independently verify direct provider terms and exact product before use.

entries.name: Hong Kong Observatory public tropical cyclone and marine warnings
entries.spatial_scope: Hong Kong and western North Pacific warning context
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Regional storm tracks, warning signals and coastal conditions, field availability varies
entries.note: Treat HKO warnings as official local alert context, not standardized loss footprints; pin issue time, basin, warning area and authoritative product. Discovery evidence: World Monitor source-attribution manifest host data.weather.gov.hk, code scripts/natural/western-pacific-cyclones.mjs; independently verify direct provider terms and exact product before use.

entries.name: India Meteorological Department coastal and sea-area bulletins
entries.spatial_scope: Indian coastal waters and adjacent sea areas
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Warnings for wind, sea state, visibility, port signals and surge by coastal area
entries.note: The upstream World Monitor documentation notes non-commercial RTI constraints for IMD; access and commercial rights require independent review. Pin bulletin area, valid interval and issuing office. Discovery evidence: World Monitor source-attribution manifest host mausam.imd.gov.in, code scripts/lib/imd-cyclone-marine.mjs; independently verify direct provider terms and exact product before use.

entries.name: Environment and Climate Change Canada public weather alerts
entries.temporal_scope: near-real-time warnings with issue and expiry windows
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Regional public watches, warnings and advisories
entries.note: An alert polygon or warning region is not an observed hazard footprint. Freeze product ID, issue time, language and validity window; assess reuse terms. Discovery evidence: World Monitor source-attribution manifest host api.weather.gc.ca, code scripts/_weather-alert-select.mjs; independently verify direct provider terms and exact product before use.

entries.name: WMO Severe Weather Information Centre 3.0
entries.spatial_scope: multi-country worldwide member coverage, incomplete by member
entries.resolution_or_granularity: CAP member advisories and tropical cyclone tracks with source agency identity
entries.note: SWIC aggregates member warnings, with incomplete CAP availability; original national meteorological services are the authoritative issuers. Avoid interpreting absence as no warning. Discovery evidence: World Monitor source-attribution manifest host severeweather.wmo.int, code scripts/_weather-alert-select.mjs; independently verify direct provider terms and exact product before use.

entries.name: ReliefWeb disasters and situation reports API
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Disaster records, country associations, reports, original sources and update times
entries.note: Official API requires approved appname. Report text and embedded content have independent publisher rights. Not insured losses or independent validation if sourced from the same agencies. Discovery evidence: World Monitor source-attribution manifest host api.reliefweb.int, code scripts/seed-climate-disasters.mjs; independently verify direct provider terms and exact product before use.

entries.name: IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix aggregated displacement API
entries.spatial_scope: country and subnational coverage where active
entries.temporal_scope: survey and assessment rounds, varies by operation
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Aggregated internally displaced population counts by administrative level
entries.note: DTM aggregates at country/admin levels with sampling and coverage differences. Never equate displacement with insured loss or identify individual households. Discovery evidence: World Monitor source-attribution manifest host dtmapi.iom.int, code scripts/seed-dtm-displacement.mjs; independently verify direct provider terms and exact product before use.

entries.name: UNHCR Refugee Data Portal datasets and API
entries.provider: United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees
entries.temporal_scope: periodic releases, country and indicator dependent
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Aggregated refugee and displacement indicators and metadata
entries.note: Not a catastrophe event feed or household exposure inventory. Preserve definitions and publication timing; avoid double counting IOM and UNHCR populations. Discovery evidence: World Monitor source-attribution manifest host data.unhcr.org, code scripts/seed-cross-border-arrivals.mjs; independently verify direct provider terms and exact product before use.

entries.name: IMF PortWatch port activity and maritime trade monitoring
entries.spatial_scope: global maritime ports and shipping routes, product dependent
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Port calls, chokepoint activity and trade disruption indicators
entries.note: Shipping data are operational proxies, not cargo value at risk or insured business interruption. Preserve port identifiers, coverage, aggregation and methodological changes. Discovery evidence: World Monitor source-attribution manifest host portwatch.imf.org, code scripts/build-chokepoint-transit-snapshot.mjs; independently verify direct provider terms and exact product before use.

entries.name: Global Energy Monitor Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Pipelines, LNG terminals, project phases, capacity and approximate or mapped locations
entries.note: Pipeline routes may be approximate and proposed projects are not operating exposure. Preserve release, status, source geometry precision, and exact CC attribution conditions. Discovery evidence: World Monitor source-attribution manifest host globalenergymonitor.org, code scripts/import-gem-pipelines.mjs; independently verify direct provider terms and exact product before use.

entries.name: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform electricity system data
entries.provider: European Network of Transmission System Operators for Electricity
entries.temporal_scope: operational and historic system time series
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Generation, load, transmission flows and outages where available
entries.note: Grid time series are not property vulnerability or claim data. Freeze bidding zones, temporal resolution, revisions and licensing terms. Discovery evidence: World Monitor source-attribution manifest host web-api.tp.entsoe.eu, code scripts/seed-electricity-prices.mjs; independently verify direct provider terms and exact product before use.

entries.name: OpenAQ global air-quality measurement API
entries.spatial_scope: global network coverage with large spatial gaps
entries.temporal_scope: measurement observations and updates, station dependent
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Station observations of particulate matter and other air pollutants
entries.note: Smoke particles are not fire perimeter or loss. Station and sensor biases and contributor-specific rights require separate verification. Discovery evidence: World Monitor source-attribution manifest host api.openaq.org, code scripts/seed-health-air-quality.mjs; independently verify direct provider terms and exact product before use.

entries.name: NSIDC Sea Ice Index G02135
entries.provider: National Snow and Ice Data Center
entries.temporal_scope: daily and monthly historic series from 1978
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Extent and concentration reference products, time series and GIS files
entries.note: Not a storm-loss input. Use as polar marine hazard conditioning with product version, quality flags and observation gaps. Discovery evidence: World Monitor source-attribution manifest host noaadata.apps.nsidc.org, code scripts/seed-climate-ocean-ice.mjs; independently verify direct provider terms and exact product before use.

entries.name: World Bank World Development Indicators API v2
entries.temporal_scope: annual and other periodic indicators by series
entries.resolution_or_granularity: National population and economic indicators with methodology and vintage
entries.note: Country averages are not geolocated building exposure or insured values. Freeze indicator IDs, unit, country, release and missing-value semantics. Discovery evidence: World Monitor source-attribution manifest host api.worldbank.org, code scripts/_demographics-capability-source.mjs; independently verify direct provider terms and exact product before use.
